hands_on_labs.title: First-power board bring-up
hands_on_labs.objective: Bring up a new MCU board safely and produce repeatable evidence.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Use a current-limited supply, meter, scope and debug probe on an unverified board.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Inspection checklist, rail table, current waveform, reset and clock evidence, minimal GPIO firmware and issue log.

hands_on_labs.title: GPIO debounce and safe startup
hands_on_labs.objective: Implement a nonblocking button input and output that remains safe through reset.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: A mechanical switch drives an interrupt and an LED or low-power load is controlled by GPIO.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Waveform capture, debounce state machine, long-press tests and reset-state verification.

hands_on_labs.title: Timer, PWM and input capture
hands_on_labs.objective: Generate precise PWM and measure a pulse using hardware capture.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Connect one timer output to a capture input on a development board.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Clock calculation, firmware, frequency and duty measurements, jitter table and rollover test.

hands_on_labs.title: ADC calibration and error budget
hands_on_labs.objective: Build and calibrate a complete analog measurement chain.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Measure a stable divided voltage with the MCU ADC and a calibrated meter.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Schematic, settling calculation, raw samples, calibration coefficients and error budget.
success_criteria: Open and saturated inputs are tested

hands_on_labs.title: UART framed protocol with fault injection
hands_on_labs.objective: Create a recoverable serial command protocol.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Exchange variable-length messages and inject loss, corruption and overrun.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Frame specification, encoder, decoder, checksum, timeout and resynchronization results.

hands_on_labs.title: I2C bus and stuck-low recovery
hands_on_labs.objective: Configure two devices and recover from a peripheral holding SDA low.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Use sensors or simulated targets and reset one during a transfer.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Pull-up calculation, capture, timeout logic and recovery demonstration.

hands_on_labs.title: SPI flash integrity test
hands_on_labs.objective: Read identification, write a safe test sector and verify data.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Use an SPI NOR device with a reserved noncritical region.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Mode and clock setup, trace, erase-write-read code and CRC evidence.

hands_on_labs.title: CAN or Modbus network fault test
hands_on_labs.objective: Demonstrate timeout, stale-data handling and recovery.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Use two nodes or a simulator and inject disconnect, malformed and repeated frames.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Network setup, fault script, communication state machine and safe-state evidence.

hands_on_labs.title: FreeRTOS producer-consumer pipeline
hands_on_labs.objective: Build a bounded data pipeline with visible backpressure.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: A producer intentionally outpaces a consumer during selected stress periods.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Task design, queue sizing, overflow policy, stack measurements and timing trace.

hands_on_labs.title: Priority inversion reproduction
hands_on_labs.objective: Reproduce inversion and verify a mitigation.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Low, medium and high priority tasks share one protected resource.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Before-and-after trace, lock analysis, inheritance or queue-based fix and regression test.

hands_on_labs.title: Zephyr devicetree board overlay
hands_on_labs.objective: Run one sensor application on two hardware configurations without source edits.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Use two supported boards or two overlays with changed bus and GPIO assignments.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Overlay, binding evidence, build targets and successful output for both variants.

hands_on_labs.title: Peripheral driver state machine
hands_on_labs.objective: Create a driver with initialization, timeout, fault and recovery states.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Use a real or simulated I2C or SPI peripheral that can NACK or delay.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Interface, state diagram, mocked tests, target test and error-code table.

hands_on_labs.title: Hard-fault capture and symbolication
hands_on_labs.objective: Capture a deliberate fault and reconstruct the failing line offline.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Trigger an invalid access and retain fault registers or a coredump.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Crash record, build ID, symbolication transcript and root-cause explanation.

hands_on_labs.title: Logic-analyzer bus diagnosis
hands_on_labs.objective: Diagnose a deliberately wrong SPI mode or weak I2C pull-up.
hands_on_labs.scenario_or_setup: Capture failing and corrected electrical behavior.
hands_on_labs.deliverables: Hypothesis, annotated captures, timing comparison and verified root cause.

practical_scenarios.title: Reset during radio transmit
practical_scenarios.situation: Battery devices reset only at maximum transmit power and more often with a long cable.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Capture supply and reset at the MCU, check regulator transient response, return path and decoupling, then verify across voltage and temperature.

practical_scenarios.title: Firmware hangs after weeks
practical_scenarios.situation: The watchdog restarts the unit but no useful evidence survives.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Preserve reset cause, task health, allocation and breadcrumbs; reproduce long-duration load and make watchdog service reflect real subsystem health.

practical_scenarios.title: I2C bus stuck low
practical_scenarios.situation: A peripheral loses power mid-transaction and holds SDA low.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Stop transfers, execute clock and STOP recovery, reset or isolate the target, reinitialize and degrade safely if recovery fails.

practical_scenarios.title: Deadline miss after logging change
practical_scenarios.situation: A control loop misses timing only when logging and networking are active.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Measure WCET and blocking, move formatting and I/O off the critical path and add a timing regression limit.

practical_scenarios.title: Boot failure after OTA power loss
practical_scenarios.situation: Some devices no longer start after power interruption during update.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Use atomic slot metadata and known-good fallback, test every interruption point and expose recovery state to fleet operations.

practical_scenarios.title: Protocol breaks on new CPU
practical_scenarios.situation: A binary message fails after moving to different endianness.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Replace native structure serialization with explicit fixed-width encoding and shared golden vectors.

practical_scenarios.title: Noisy production sensor lot
practical_scenarios.situation: Only one assembly lot shows drift and noise.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Correlate component, calibration and station records, measure raw analog and supply behavior and quarantine affected units.

practical_scenarios.title: Online device but failed actuator
practical_scenarios.situation: MQTT stays connected while a jammed actuator never reaches position.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Separate connectivity from functional health, validate local position and timeout and stop unsafe repeated actuation.

practical_scenarios.title: Certificate rollover outage
practical_scenarios.situation: Older devices reject the new server certificate.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Identify trust assumptions, stage overlapping anchors before cutover and test future rollover without disabling validation.

practical_scenarios.title: Battery life misses by 10x
practical_scenarios.situation: The MCU reaches deep sleep but the product lasts one month.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Measure the complete current waveform and find regulator, sensor, retry or wake-storm losses before recalculating.

practical_scenarios.title: CAN bus-off near motor start
practical_scenarios.situation: The controller repeatedly enters bus-off when a motor energizes.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Inspect termination, ground and transients, use error counters and define controlled rejoin after fixing the noise source.

practical_scenarios.title: Unreproducible firmware image
practical_scenarios.situation: The exact deployed binary and map cannot be rebuilt.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Treat it as release-control failure, recover all available metadata and implement pinned builds and artifact retention.

practical_scenarios.title: Production debug left open
practical_scenarios.situation: Retail units expose SWD with full flash access.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Assess exposure, enable supported debug restriction or authentication with a service strategy and verify manufacturing configuration.

practical_scenarios.title: BLE pairing without authorization
practical_scenarios.situation: Any paired phone can write a safety-sensitive characteristic.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Separate pairing from application authorization, restrict GATT permissions and require role and state checks.

practical_scenarios.title: Crash logs fill root filesystem
practical_scenarios.situation: A Linux gateway restarts continuously and persistent logs consume storage.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Rate-limit restart, cap logs, preserve first useful evidence and roll back or repair before restart.

practical_scenarios.title: Plausible but stale telemetry
practical_scenarios.situation: A dashboard shows normal values six hours after sampling stopped.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Carry source time and sequence, monitor age and prevent stale data from being treated as current.

practical_scenarios.title: MCU end-of-life crisis
practical_scenarios.situation: A key MCU becomes unavailable and firmware is vendor-coupled.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Quantify supply, isolate dependencies, prototype migration and plan certification and field support.

practical_scenarios.title: Remote command executes twice
practical_scenarios.situation: A retry causes a valve-open action to occur twice after reconnect.
practical_scenarios.preferred_response: Require command IDs, expiry and state preconditions and redesign the local action to be idempotent and safe.
